{{Top|leg}}
'''Molly's Merchants''' were a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] organization composed of [[Information broker/Legends|infochants]], [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]], and electronic forgers. They were hired by [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]] to transfer funds from their parent company [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] to their own accounts. Bespin Motors then used the money to buy-out their company from Incom and go independent.
